_about: Pass/fail thresholds for stage 1, written 2026-11-28 before run.py was first executed. Each check compares one key of results/<id>.json 'metrics' with max (value <= x), min (value >= x), both, or equals. Thresholds are not loosened to make a task pass; a changed threshold keeps its old value and the reason under 'changes'.

1.01.title: Import the Go2 model
1.01.basis: 24 links and 12 revolute joints counted in docs/06 Task 1.3 and 2.2 on the same xacro

1.02.title: Display the model in RViz
1.02.basis: every URDF link must resolve as a tf2 transform from base_link; RViz must stay up and draw a non-uniform image

1.03.title: Identify the 12 actuated joints
1.03.basis: CHAMP's leg model hard-codes hip about x, thigh and knee about y (docs/06 Task 5.4); joints.yaml lists the joint names CHAMP commands

1.04.title: Move one joint and check the rotation
1.04.basis: robot_state_publisher computes the same chain in double precision; 1e-6 m allows float printing and quaternion normalisation; a positive rotation about +y moves a point below the axis towards -x

1.05.title: Move the three joints of one leg
1.05.basis: 25 random in-limit configurations of the left front leg; every leg link and the foot compared with numpy forward kinematics

1.06.title: Modify a joint limit in a copy of the URDF
1.06.basis: lf_hip_joint upper limit 1.0472 -> 0.3 in the copy; lf and rf hips both commanded 0.6 rad outward on a fixed-base rig; 0.02 rad allows ODE's soft joint stop; rf (limit unchanged) must reach 0.6 within 0.03 rad

1.07.title: Add a sensor link and check TF
1.07.basis: rear_cam_link at (-0.25, 0, 0.06), yaw pi, as in docs/06 Task 4

1.08.title: Spawn in an empty Gazebo world
1.08.basis: CHAMP nominal_height 0.225 m (gait.yaml) below the hip axes, which sit at base_link height, plus the 0.02 m foot sphere radius: predicted base height 0.245 m; 10 s sim-time hold

1.09.title: Floor and obstacles with collision geometry
1.09.basis: box front face 1.5 m ahead of the spawn point; first collision shape to touch it is the hip cylinder, 0.1934 + 0.046 = 0.2394 m ahead of base_link, so the predicted gap base_link to face is 0.2394 m

1.10.title: Read joint states
1.10.basis: standard stack (sim.launch.py, empty world); controller manager update_rate 250 Hz (ros_control.yaml), rate measured in sim time from header stamps
